label: Adapted Foucauldian archaeology to expose the colonial invention of Africa
description: Using Foucault’s archaeology of epistemes, Mudimbe excavated how Western missionary, anthropological, and philosophical texts produced "Africa" as a foil for European reason.
dialecticalTension: Turns post-structural archaeology against Eurocentric Africanist knowledge regimes.

label: Interrogated Négritude’s counter-discourse for remaining tethered to colonial binaries
description: While honoring Césaire’s revolt, Mudimbe showed how early Négritude and ethnophilosophy risked reproducing Western essentialist categories in inverted form.
dialecticalTension: Moves from anti-colonial reversal to deconstructive critique of Africanist gnosis.

label: Conceptualized colonial gnosis and the colonial library
description: Mudimbe defined the colonial library as the institutional apparatus of European concepts through which Africa was classified and governed.
dialecticalTension: Reveals epistemic colonization underlying modern disciplines.
historicalContext: The Invention of Africa (1988) & The Idea of Africa (1994).

label: Laid the epistemological groundwork for Mbembe’s critique of the postcolony
description: Mbembe’s On the Postcolony directly builds upon Mudimbe’s archaeology of colonial gnosis to interrogate postcolonial sovereignty and African self-writing.
dialecticalTension: Bridges archaeological deconstruction of "Africa" with necropolitical theory.
